acceptance:
今天（紅）：production 卡翻到背面，例句仍是 "…out of the ______, so to speak."；原始碼側 `mode: .cloze` 這個常數存在於 `TodayReviewPresenter+CardContent.swift:595`，`ReviewCardExampleRendering` 這個型別不存在，測試檔也沒有任何 (face, cardMode) 真值表——判準 exit 1 並印出 "cloze still hardcoded at a render call site"。實測 rc=1。

修好後（綠）：production 正面例句仍挖空（那是唯一還沒揭曉答案的面），production 背面與 recognition 兩面都改回高亮——舊版截圖那種 "…had a **slate** stone sidewalk running…"，粗體＋highlightMark 底色。

**判準證明什麼**：五段程式文字，全部取自待修檔案自己的原始碼——(a) `.example` 分支仍經 `CardRichTextRenderer.text(` 渲染（否則 exit 3）；(b) `ios/BooksAndVocab` 全樹不得再有 `mode: .cloze` 字面；(c) `.example` 分支傳的 `mode:` 引數逐字是 `ReviewCardExampleRendering.mode(face: face, cardMode: card.reviewMode)`；(d) **helper 的函式本體去空白後含 `face==.front&&cardMode==.production?.cloze:.highlight`**——這條在管「決策本身」，不只管有沒有接線；(e) 測試檔對四種 (face, cardMode) 組合**各自**斷言了期望值（.front×.production == .cloze，其餘三格 == .highlight），四行同組合不算數。缺一即紅。

**判準證明不了什麼（誠實的殘留）**：它不編譯、不跑測試。「這份 Swift 編得過」與「那四個 #expect 執行時真的綠」只能由收尾的 `./ops/ios_ops.sh build` 與 `./ops/ios_ops.sh test --file ios/BooksAndVocabTests/ReviewCardRenderPlanTests.swift` 講，兩條都必須在 receipt 裡附當下輸出。判準是回歸錨（擋這個缺陷再長回來），不是行為證明的全部。
acceptance_cmd:
set -x; set -e
c=ios/BooksAndVocab/Views/Vocabulary/Scenes/ReviewCardView.swift
l=ios/BooksAndVocab/Views/Vocabulary/Scenes/ReviewCardLayout.swift
t=ios/BooksAndVocabTests/ReviewCardRenderPlanTests.swift
for f in "$c" "$l" "$t"; do if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "missing $f" >&2; exit 3; fi; done
body=$(awk 'p&&/^        case /{exit} /^        case \.example:/{p=1} p' "$c")
if ! printf '%s' "$body" | grep -qF 'CardRichTextRenderer.text('; then echo 'example branch no longer renders through CardRichTextRenderer' >&2; exit 3; fi
if grep -rqE 'mode: *\.cloze' ios/BooksAndVocab; then echo 'cloze still hardcoded at a render call site' >&2; exit 1; fi
if ! printf '%s' "$body" | grep -qE 'mode: *ReviewCardExampleRendering\.mode\(face: *face, *cardMode: *card\.reviewMode\)'; then echo 'example branch does not derive its mode from face+cardMode' >&2; exit 1; fi
helper=$(awk '/^enum ReviewCardExampleRendering/{p=1} p{print} p&&/^}/{exit}' "$l")
if [ -z "$helper" ]; then echo 'decision helper missing from ReviewCardLayout.swift' >&2; exit 1; fi
flat=$(printf '%s' "$helper" | tr -d ' \t\n\r')
case "$flat" in
  *'face==.front&&cardMode==.production?.cloze:.highlight'*) ;;
  *) echo 'helper does not decide cloze from face+cardMode; expected body: face == .front && cardMode == .production ? .cloze : .highlight' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
for combo in front:production:cloze back:production:highlight front:recognition:highlight back:recognition:highlight; do
  f=${combo%%:*}; rest=${combo#*:}; m=${rest%%:*}; want=${rest#*:}
  if ! grep -qE "ReviewCardExampleRendering\.mode\(face: *\.$f, *cardMode: *\.$m\) *== *\.$want" "$t"; then
    echo "truth table missing: (face: .$f, cardMode: .$m) is not asserted == .$want" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
